messages:
Sam: FYI — customer Acme (acct acme-42) reporting prod failures on /v1/invoke -> function price_lookup, started 2026-03-16T10:02:54Z. Error returned: InvalidArguments: unexpected field 'currency_code'.

Sam: Repro (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/invoke
{
  "tool": "price_lookup",
  "args": {"product_id": "1234", "region": "us-east-1", "quantity": 2, "currency_code": "USD"}
}
```

Maria: thanks — can you paste the full runtime log and request_id?

Sam: request_id=rid_8a9c2b. Runtime snippet:
```
[runtime] validating args for price_lookup
schema: {product_id: integer, region: string, quantity: integer}
received: {product_id: "1234", region: "us-east-1", quantity: 2, currency_code: "USD"}
validation failed: unexpected key 'currency_code' -> 400
```

Jon: dev note: we merged the golden prompt normalization change in deploy 2026-03-15 that removed arg passthrough for optional keys; CI toolcall-schema-suite didn't catch unknown-key regressions — it only checks required fields and types.

Kiara: customer impact? Affected only hosted region us-east-1 or also dedicated?

Sam: so far only hosted (prod) for Acme and one other small customer; both hit after last deploy. Dedicated customers on pin 1.2 are fine.

Maria: immediate mitigation: we can push a runtime shim to ignore/strip unknown keys for price_lookup for 48h. Also add a request-level fallback that maps currency_code -> currency if present.

Jon: agree. Long term: extend schema tests to assert no-unknown-keys and add golden-prompt regression that exercises toolcall outputs with extra args. Also add a CI gate: failing when unknown-key present in any golden run.

Kiara: can we hotfix without full rollback? If we change runtime to allow unknown keys, need small patch: runtime v2.8.1 to accept unknown keys with warn only.

Sam: will create support ticket and send customer workaround (send args as nested 'params' object) and enable temporary shim. Draft message to Acme: we are rolling a targeted fix, ETA 2h.

deploy-bot: deploy started for runtime v2.8.1-hotfix @kiara

Kiara: rolling now, monitor traces. please add any failing request_ids to #incidents.

Jon: callback action items:
- eng-runtime: patch to ignore unknown keys for 48h (Kiara)
- eng-ml: revert golden normalization or add compatibility layer in model prompting (Maria/Jon)
- devex: add test case to toolcall-schema-suite + golden prompts (Sam/Jon)

Sam: added thread to support ticket SUP-6421, customer updated. I'll post postmortem template after fix.

Maria: thanks all. please ping if Acme reports progress. :thumbsup:
